## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (98%)** · Confident · Careful review
Conformal set is InSitu only [F1], but the second model and all 5 neighbors disagree.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 98%, Normal 1% | Strongly peaked |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / percentile 1.0 | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Models disagree |
| Similar cases | 0/5 InSitu | None match; Normal/Benign [F5] |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 1) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score; lowers concept-model invasive association [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Typical score; spot check 0/20, not a reason [F3] · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 3, 9) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score; spot check 0/20 [F4] · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 1) · ↓ invasive · Low score; slightly lowers invasive association · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; fits in situ, near-zero weight · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion CI excludes 0 (+0.54 logit, 0.47–0.60); heatmap is faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (+0.002, −0.005 to 0.007); not shown to reflect the classifier. Mitoses and normal lobules are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Blur (severity 3) on a simulated frozen section distorts embeddings; second model disagrees.
- True class is Normal or Benign, as all 5 neighbors suggest.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 3**: confirm atypical cells are confined within ducts; mitoses score here failed spot check.
2. **Region 1**: strongest stromal-invasion score; confirm no stromal invasion.
3. **Regions 9, 11**: check whether blur mimics mitoses (9) or normal lobules (11).
